title: What It Actually Looks Like to Serve Your Roommates and Still Have a Spine
caption:
There are two bad roommates. The one who never lifts a finger, and the one who does everything, never says a word, and quietly resents everybody.

A godly man is neither. He goes first: dishes, trash, the job nobody claimed, with no speech about it. And when something has to be said, he says it once, face to face, plain and kind.

The same Jesus who washed feet flipped tables.

Send this to the guy you share a kitchen with.

#faith #godlyman #roommates #servantleadership #christianmen
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
